messages:
janet_support: Customer opened a billing escalation — invoice shows ~1,916 tokens for a streaming session but their local SDK estimator reports 1,892. Customer reports a ~24-token delta across ~12 requests. attaching repro and ask for triage. request_id: req_20260312_88ab

ryan_devx: can you paste a minimal repro (curl) + the estimator output? Also confirm streaming vs non-streaming.

janet_support: Minimal repro below (PII removed):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"gpt-xyz",
    "messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the logs"}
    ],
    "stream": true,
    "function_call": "auto"
  }'
```

Client-side estimator output (JS SDK):

```js
// token-estimator output
{ prompt: 842, completion: 1050, total: 1892 }
```

But metering API and invoice show total_tokens: 1916 and the billed invoice has 1916 tokens.

maria_billing: did the customer use any tool calls that returned structured metadata? tool wrappers sometimes add metadata fields that the metering service counts.

janet_support: yes — function was invoked and the tool returned a small JSON with fields like `tool_name` and `duration_ms`. The SDK estimator seems to omit tool metadata. Attached API response snippet for the same request:

```json
{
  "id":"res_abc",
  "choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"...","metadata":{"tool_name":"log_extractor","_kv":"session:1234"}}}]
}
```

siva_sre: fyi we rolled a metering change last week that started counting serialized tool metadata and internal resume prefixes as part of completion tokens when streaming reconnects occur. internal rollout note: https://internal.redwood/release/metering-tool-metadata (internal link).

ryan_devx: streaming reconnects? customer used `stream: true` above. do logs show a resume where we inject prefixes that the client doesn't see?

janet_support: yes — logs show a reconnect at 2026-03-12T14:12:05Z. resumed chunks include an internal prefix marker `\u0002RESUME_META|tool:log_extractor|seq:5` that our sidecar serializes into the stream and metering counts. The client-side estimator never observes that since it only tokenizes the user/assistant content pre-send.

maria_billing: next steps: 1) ping @metering-team to confirm whether resume-prefixes/tool-metadata are intended to be billable, 2) ask infra to expose an optional estimator flag (include_resume_prefixes) so SDKs can match server counts, 3) prepare customer-facing explanation + potential credit flow depending on policy.

billing-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-334 and assigned to @metering-team. ETA: 48h.

janet_support: compiling a list of affected request ids and uploading logs to the ticket.

maria_billing: if metering-team confirms these internal prefixes are billable we should update docs + SDK estimator to call out streaming-resume inflation, and consider a policy to waive tiny internal-prefix-only charges.

siva_sre: logging/action item — add a boolean trace flag trace.resume_prefix = true when resume prefixes are applied, so billing queries can filter historic cases if needed.

janet_support: uploaded examples: req_20260312_88ab, req_20260312_90bc, req_20260312_99ef. will update customer once metering-team responds. :handshake:
